title: Reader daemon: POST path — validation, signing, IPFS write, log append, publish
description: Implement the full POST pipeline in the reader daemon. A client sends POST, the daemon validates headers and article body at ingress, operator-signs the canonical bytes with ed25519, writes the block to IPFS, records the CID in the Message-ID map, appends to each group log named in Newsgroups:, publishes tip over gossipsub, assigns local article numbers, and responds 240. DID-signed payload passthrough is supported. No article is written to IPFS or the log without a valid operator signature.
